plan.notes: Source: UNH 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog (catalog.unh.edu/archives/2024-2025/...), 'Computer Science Major (B.S.)', College of Engineering and Physical Sciences, Durham NH — 'Sample Degree Plan'. Degree name verified: 'Computer Science Major (B.S.)' (catalog heading). Transcription method: manual verbatim transcription from the official catalog PDF text via the search index (direct PDF fetch was unavailable in this environment); every term cross-checked against the 2021-2022 and 2022-2023 UNH catalog archives, which carry the same plan structure. total_credits=130 is the Sample Degree Plan's own published total (18+16+16+16+16+16+18+14=130); the catalog's requirements section prints 'Total Credits 129-130', so the plan's own total is used per pipeline rule. Caveats: (1) The published plan lists a MATH 531/539/644 choice in BOTH Year 2 Fall and Year 2 Spring; both are transcribed as printed. (2) CS 518/CS 527 are an either/or pair across Year 2 Fall/Spring (take one per term). (3) CS 501 satisfies Discovery II; CS 761 may satisfy Discovery III; CS 758 may satisfy Discovery V — the plan's '(or Discovery N)' annotations are preserved as choice slots. (4) Catalog requires a grade of C or better in CS 410C, CS 410P, CS 415, CS 416, CS 420, CS 515, CS 520, IT 403; overall GPA 2.0. (5) Discovery footnote: 7 categories (Historical Perspectives, Humanities, Fine and Performing Arts, Social Science, World Cultures, Physical Science Discovery Lab, Biological Science Discovery Lab); one Biological Science and one Physical Science course with Discovery lab required, one with Writing Intensive attribute. (6) Professional electives: CEPS approved list or non-introductory CEPS course approved by the undergraduate studies committee. No prereqs are stated in the Sample Degree Plan itself, so all prereq arrays are empty (not invented).
